review.scientific: Internal pass: checked core receptor/ligand distinctions, TPO feedback and clearance, NO/PGI2, GPVI, ADP and TXA2 signalling, fibrinogen bridging, VWD/platelet defects, experimental caveats and primary/secondary boundary against indexed sources. Recomputed turnover, Poiseuille ratios, shear, aggregation normalisation, production/clearance, kinetic and flow-cytometry exercises. Reviewed all 54 keys; post-reordering correct option text unchanged in every item.
review.editorial: Separate pass: expanded 15 misconception explanations, 12 active recall prompts, revision, figure title/zoom controls, improved Q30 distractors, reordered keys, verified 147 unique paragraphs, heading/anchor and reader structure. No external peer review.

score_basis: Internal assessment. Scientific mechanisms and numeric answers checked; all roadmap content mapped. Deductions for occasional compact exposition, no rendered SVG visual test, some simpler distractors, no assistive/browser runtime test, and no prepublication live check. Indexed sources inspected, not all full texts.
limitations: No independent peer review; not all full-text sources inspected.
No mobile/browser/assistive-technology runtime test; SVG accessibility and integrity statically checked.
